summary.text: Randell Shafer is the Republican candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 12, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Kimberly L. Edwards.
He was also the Republican nominee for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Randell Shafer advanced from the Republican primary for District 12 on August 6, 2024, receiving 3,296 votes in an uncontested race.
He lost the November 5, 2024 general election to Edwards, receiving 13,609 votes (30.3 percent) to her 31,256 (69.7 percent).
Shafer won the 2026 Republican primary for District 12 on August 4, 2026, defeating Brian Hakola with 1,999 votes (57.8 percent) to 1,462.
